provenance_note: Hand-authored; no tenant contacted. Inventory GET /items is the ONE TRUE DELTA in the whole matrix: last_modified_time is both filterable and sortable here, which is why items_delta_filter is True on this product and False on ERP. Note the timestamp format -- yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, NOT the offset-bearing stamp Books bills and POs take. Two formats on two services, held apart on purpose. Books also has an item list and is deliberately not used for this poll: it has no delta filter, so routing here would make a full scan look like a window.
